branch.description: The branch to run the pipeline on (e.g., "main", "feature/my-branch"). If left empty, the default branch will be used

pipelineId.description: The numeric ID of the pipeline to trigger

projectId.description: The ID or name of the project (Default: no default project)

stagesToSkip.description: Stages to skip in the pipeline run

variables.description: Variables to pass to the pipeline run
